pages.title: Typeblade: Shadow Dojo
pages.creator: 9five
pages.description: Defend a dojo through typed attacks in Typeblade: Shadow Dojo. Enter an enemy word's first letter to lock on, then finish the word to strike. Build combos and multipliers while surviving warriors, armored guards, and bosses through a twenty-wave trial or additional challenges.

pages.title: Merge and Harvest
pages.creator: bestphysics
pages.description: Build a market by combining produce in Merge and Harvest. Use production stations to create goods, merge identical items into higher-level products, and fill customer orders. Spend the earned coins on more board space and additional stations as the business expands.

pages.title: War Space
pages.creator: War Space
pages.description: Grow a celestial body in War Space by consuming food, debris, and rival planets. Split your mass for attacks or shed some to escape danger, then time the pieces' reunion. The multiplayer contest revolves around gaining size without losing your advantage to another player.

pages.title: Candy Match Move
pages.creator: lilina
pages.description: Rearrange sweets into removable pairs in Candy Match Move. Clear adjacent identical pieces or slide one along its row or column to reach a partner. Empty each timed board and use bombs, shuffles, or freezing boosters when the arrangement becomes difficult.

pages.title: African Princesses: Style Island
pages.creator: DL-studio
pages.description: Style two friends for a tropical celebration in African Princesses: Style Island. Choose hairstyles, makeup, and African-inspired outfits, then add jewelry, sunglasses, or handbags. Coordinate Tiara and Zania's completed looks for their appearance in the island's fashion show.

pages.title: Escape from the Portal
pages.creator: Mirra Games
pages.description: Open a route back to the living world in Escape from the Portal. Explore catacombs, avoid traps, and fight monsters while searching for magical artifacts and secrets. Interact with the surroundings and use the inventory to work toward activating the ancient portal.

pages.title: Sokoban Push The Box
pages.creator: PuzzleGame.Com
pages.description: Push every crate onto its destination in Sokoban Push The Box. Navigate tight corridors and consider what each shove leaves behind, because a box in the wrong corner can block further progress. Plan a complete solution while watching the number of moves used.

pages.title: С21A
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Build card totals of twenty-one in С21A. Choose how to combine the cards without exceeding the target and losing the attempt. The continuing card challenge asks you to balance adding value with preserving a valid hand as you try to improve your result.

pages.title: Happy Monsters
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Collect fruit through a set of minigames in Happy Monsters. Help the creatures gather as much produce as possible during their different activities. Earn animal postcards from the results and work toward completing the full collection of illustrated rewards.

pages.title: Color 3D - Bump It Up
pages.creator: Tiny Castle Studio
pages.description: Clear a forward-moving ball's route in Color 3D - Bump It Up. Touch only obstacles sharing the character's color and avoid differently colored pieces. A wrong-color collision restarts the attempt, so choose the path through the arrangement before the ball reaches it.

pages.title: Student and Teacher
pages.creator: Starodymov Games
pages.description: Cause fictional school chaos in Student and Teacher. Break objects such as laptops and chairs while staying out of trouble with the staff. The character's revenge plan depends on disrupting the surroundings without being caught by the teacher or head teacher.

pages.title: Tricky Arrow 2
pages.creator: Fantasy Realm
pages.description: Fire arrows into a rotating target in Tricky Arrow 2. Choose open spaces between the arrows already embedded in the circle and time each new shot carefully. Continued rotation changes the safe opening, making later hits harder to place without a collision.

pages.title: Stickboys Hook
pages.creator: FBK
pages.description: Carry a stick figure across aerial courses in Stickboys Hook. Use ramps for jumps and shoot web lines to swing toward the finish. Keep connecting the movements without falling from the sky as you work to complete each level.

pages.title: Snake Hunter
pages.creator: FantasyTalk
pages.description: Protect a homeland from giant serpents in Snake Hunter. Attack the sections of their long bodies, gather dropped skills, and apply buffs to improve your weapons. Strengthen the defenses and adapt your fighting as different snakes appear in successive levels.

pages.title: Brawler Man: Fist of Fury
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Clear city streets through close-range combat in Brawler Man: Fist of Fury. Click a strike icon for an individual blow or hold and drag through several icons to create a combination. Use those sequences to defeat hooligans across the city's encounters.

pages.title: Army Fight 3d
pages.creator: Online Games
pages.description: Develop an army in Army Fight 3d. Create units and upgrade the force while defending your base against the opposition. Balance the protection of your position with building enough strength to defeat the enemy in the ongoing battle.

pages.title: Candy Battle: Sweet Survivors
pages.creator: Gametok
pages.description: Fight to stay alive in Candy Battle: Sweet Survivors. Guide a warrior through a city overrun by zombies and confront the horde alongside other survivors. The enemies outnumber the defenders, making each encounter part of holding on through the crisis.

pages.title: Hotel Fever Tycoon
pages.creator: Yizhiyuan Network Technology Co., Ltd.
pages.description: Build a hospitality business with Emma and Uncle George in Hotel Fever Tycoon. Complete guests' orders, handle cooking duties, and improve the hotel through sustained service. Efficient work opens additional themed properties as the pair develops a larger hotel chain.

pages.title: Stick Man Battle Fighting
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Choose a weapon and confront rivals in Stick Man Battle Fighting. Customize the stick-figure hero, explore different fighting styles, and work through single-player battles. Use the available moves to defeat enemies as the combat encounters continue.

pages.title: Broomcraft Mystic Evasion
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description: Survive an airborne horde in Broomcraft Mystic Evasion. Move on a magical broom, rush away from danger, and defeat enemies for experience. Choose spells when leveling up and evolve them into stronger attacks to handle the increasing enemy waves.

pages.title: Rainbow Balls 2048
pages.creator: IT-Hype
pages.description: Drop and merge numbered spheres in Rainbow Balls 2048. Matching balls combine under physics, producing larger values and adding to the score. Work toward reaching 2048 while using the available booster to help with a difficult arrangement.

pages.title: Pixel Demolisher Cannon
pages.creator: Hihoy
pages.description: Destroy block-built objects in Pixel Demolisher Cannon. Adjust the cannon's angle and launch bombs to create larger explosions across the pixel structures. Earn money for stronger equipment and visit bonus maps for additional opportunities to increase the payout.

pages.title: Thanksgiving Spot The Differences
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Inspect festive meal pictures in Thanksgiving Spot The Differences. Compare each pair and select the small changes between their food arrangements. Complete the search by finding the details that distinguish the otherwise similar Thanksgiving scenes.

pages.title: Halloween Makeup Trends
pages.creator: Gamerina
pages.description: Build a costume-ready beauty look in Halloween Makeup Trends. Follow influencer-inspired designs such as unicorn cosmetics or colorful Day of the Dead styling. Experiment with the available makeup choices and coordinate the details for each character's finished Halloween appearance.

pages.title: Hangman
pages.creator: CoolMath Games
pages.description: Solve clue-based word puzzles in Hangman. Guess letters to uncover the answer while protecting the balloons that keep the character away from a hungry beast. Thousands of puzzles provide different clues, giving you new words to identify before the danger reaches the player.

pages.title: Insect Pic Puzzles
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Restore close-up animal pictures in Insect Pic Puzzles. Slide an image section into the neighboring empty space to reorganize the tiles. Points decrease every second, so find a useful sequence that rebuilds the insect picture without wasting too much time.

pages.title: Crazy Traffic Racer
pages.creator: Affrica
pages.description: Steer through road traffic in Crazy Traffic Racer, keeping your car clear of other vehicles as you drive at speed. Judge the available gaps and react to cars ahead. The 3D road view makes each approach and change of direction part of the driving challenge.

pages.title: ATV Ultimate OffRoad
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Explore large riding areas in ATV Ultimate OffRoad. Enter races or drive freely across the map, alone or with a second player. Gather money and gears through racing and exploration to unlock additional all-terrain vehicles for later challenges.

pages.title: Extreme Drag Racing
pages.creator: Xenolia
pages.description: Time transmission changes to win in Extreme Drag Racing. Choose a car with its own performance characteristics and shift at useful moments to build speed. Compete against the opposing driver and work toward completing the straight-line race ahead of them.

pages.title: Tangram
pages.creator: Dumadu Games Pvt Ltd
pages.description: Reproduce a silhouette with seven polygons in Tangram. Arrange all the flat pieces so they fit the reference pattern without overlapping. Compare the angles and outlines to work out how the individual shapes combine into the required figure.

pages.title: Cinderella & Prince Charming
pages.creator: ARPAPLUS
pages.description: Prepare a storybook couple for their wedding in Cinderella & Prince Charming. Choose bridal clothing for Cinderella and coordinate an outfit for her fiancé. Use the wardrobe selections to give both characters complete looks for the ceremony.

pages.title: Metal Army War 3
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Defend Earth from another robotic attack in Metal Army War 3. Guide the returning heroes against advanced machines, including drones and assault vehicles. Work through the fighting encounters as the pair leaves its holiday behind to stop the invading forces.

pages.title: Unload the fridge
pages.creator: playmarketing ou
pages.description: Empty a stocked refrigerator in Unload the fridge. Select items from the shelves and form matching sets to remove them, making room for further selections. Work through the food and drinks before the time limit expires to clear the stage.

pages.title: Taxi Pickup
pages.creator: 2Play
pages.description: Drive passengers through busy streets in Taxi Pickup. Find customers, take them to their requested destinations, and collect fares from completed trips. Manage the traffic around the cab as you try to earn more cash than the competing drivers.

pages.title: Jewel Christmas Story
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Complete seasonal matching tasks in Jewel Christmas Story. Form combinations through gift- and sweet-themed puzzles, collect currency, and use boosters during the missions. Build useful combos as you progress through the levels celebrating the Christmas season.

pages.title: Tictoc Catwalk Fashion
pages.creator: iclickgames
pages.description: Create a model's outfit in Tictoc Catwalk Fashion. Follow the styling hint, select the right pieces, and photograph the finished look for social-media reels. Earn likes and money from those appearances, then purchase further fashion items for later catwalk looks.

pages.title: Beaver Weaver
pages.creator: Nord Beaver
pages.description: Create stitched pictures in Beaver Weaver. Select a thread color and fill individual cells or hold to stitch several, moving the canvas with the other mouse button. Boosters assist the artwork as you learn about Gloria, Mikey, and their town of Beaver Ville.

pages.title: Halloween Lonely Road Racing
pages.creator: Vitalitygames.com
pages.description: Drive through spooky courses in Halloween Lonely Road Racing. Pick a vehicle and handle the pumpkin-lined nighttime routes with keyboard steering. Use nitro when useful as you work through the atmospheric racing levels and their eerie surroundings.

pages.title: Birds Link
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Slide bird blocks together in Birds Link. Bring each piece toward an identical one to remove the pair, using as few moves as possible. Eliminations earn points, while moving a block repeatedly reduces the reward as you clear thirty-six layouts.

pages.title: Voxel Merge 3D
pages.creator: Brosco Games
pages.description: Sort a pile of block-style objects in Voxel Merge 3D. Find and combine identical pairs, break blocks, and improve the pickaxe to support further discoveries. Completed levels unlock additional items and rubies, expanding the collection available for later matching challenges.

pages.title: Screw the Nut 2
pages.creator: Garbuz Studio
pages.description: Guide a loose fastener toward its partner in Screw the Nut 2. Click supporting objects to remove them and let physics carry the nut toward the bolt. Complete each level by choosing a removal sequence that creates a workable route between the two pieces.

pages.title: Go Repo
pages.creator: Podge Games
pages.description: Direct a repossession crew in Go Repo, recovering belongings from customers who refuse to settle their debts. Move the agents through each job and handle resistance while collecting property. Force can help the operation, but injuries leave the team with hospital expenses.

pages.title: Awesome Run 2
pages.creator: Flash From The Past
pages.description: Beat three rivals in Awesome Run 2. Race along the track, collect energy boosts, and avoid obstacles that delay the runner. Use the pickups to build speed at useful moments and work toward reaching the finish ahead of the competition.

pages.title: Flex Run
pages.creator: DRA
pages.description: Dodge household objects in Flex Run. Move an agile gymnast into positions that avoid incoming furniture, using the mouse or keyboard to control the evasions. Earn points from successful passes and spend them on character customization.

pages.title: Idle Startup Tycoon
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Build a series of businesses in Idle Startup Tycoon. Develop an idea at a workstation, send the product through cloud servers, and collect revenue through sales managers. Upgrade each stage and hire managers to automate operations as new ventures become available.

pages.title: Impulse
pages.creator: Eu Game Studio
pages.description: Boost a character onto a platform in Impulse. Apply enough force to reach the landing without overshooting into the thorns above it. Each attempt depends on judging the balance between gaining height and keeping the character clear of the dangerous ceiling.

pages.title: Build tower 3D
pages.creator: gamesmunch.com
pages.description: Construct a growing skyscraper in Build tower 3D. Place the available sections to extend the building upward and work toward a taller result. Watch how each piece fits the existing structure as you try to surpass the surrounding city's towers.

pages.title: Magic Day of Knowledge
pages.creator: DL-studio
pages.description: Prepare young witches for class in Magic Day of Knowledge. Choose school-appropriate blouses, jackets, skirts, or trousers, then coordinate accessories for their first day. Combine the uniform pieces into individual looks that suit the academy's magical setting.

pages.title: Drunken Boxing 2
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Win unstable fistfights in Drunken Boxing 2. Control a swaying boxer and throw quick punches while keeping an eye on the energy bar. Running out forces a recovery pause; the first side to score five wins against the computer or another player.

pages.title: Dead City : Zombie Shooter
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Fight through a ruined city overrun by the undead in Dead City : Zombie Shooter. Aim your firearms at approaching zombies and keep attacking to survive their assaults. The first-person view puts weapon handling and awareness of nearby threats at the center of each encounter.

pages.title: Baby Fashion Tailor Shop
pages.creator: Yiv.Com
pages.description: Create clothing for waiting customers in Baby Fashion Tailor Shop. Change the designs shown in the shop window and develop new outfits for the business. The game centers on preparing garments that reflect your ideas while serving the tailor's visitors.

pages.title: Mr Spy 3D
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: Take timed shots at targets in Mr Spy 3D. Play an undercover marksman and line up enemies before firing at the useful moment. Complete the shooting assignments by placing accurate hits through the game's sequence of missions.

pages.title: Balloon Paradise
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Pop rising balloons in Balloon Paradise to build a high score. Watch the differently sized and colored balloons drift up from the bottom of the play area, then click your targets. Keep finding new balloons as the screen fills with moving opportunities to score.

pages.title: Digital Vehicles Jigsaw Puzzle 2
pages.creator: GamesFine.com
pages.description: Reassemble stylized car scenes in Digital Vehicles Jigsaw Puzzle 2. Choose one of eight images and a grid with six, twelve, or twenty-four pieces. Drag the sections into their correct positions until the selected digital-vehicle picture is complete.

pages.title: Police Boat Chase
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Escape pursuing patrols in Police Boat Chase. Steer with WASD or the arrow keys and find room between the obstacles on the water. Keep the boat out of the police's path as you work to preserve the getaway.

pages.title: Banana Bread
pages.creator: Baby Hazel
pages.description: Prepare a baked treat in Banana Bread. Follow the recipe instructions and work through the ingredient and cooking steps shown by the game. Complete the sequence to turn the components into a finished loaf flavored with bananas.

pages.title: Ellie Accident ER
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description: Treat an injured cyclist in Ellie Accident ER. Follow the illustrated medical sequence to clean the wound, remove bacteria, and apply the requested treatment. Use the provided tools to complete Ellie's care after her bicycle accident.

pages.title: Air War 1942 43
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Fight hostile aircraft in Air War 1942 43. Guide the fighter through enemy fire and shoot down as many opposing planes as possible. Collect coins during the flight to increase the score while continuing to survive the aerial battle.

pages.title: Bubble Sorting
pages.creator: Eagle Games
pages.description: Separate colored spheres in Bubble Sorting. Select a bubble and the tube where you want to place it, then keep reorganizing the groups. Finish with every color collected in its appropriate tube, planning transfers around the available space.

pages.title: Ultimate Racing Cars 3D
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Take different vehicles onto the track in Ultimate Racing Cars 3D. Choose from the available modes, including races and timed challenges, then steer through the course toward its objective. Use the arrow keys to control the car and Escape to pause the action.

pages.title: Purple Roses Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Put together floral illustrations in Purple Roses Puzzle. Choose one of six images and a layout with 16, 36, 64, or 100 pieces. Fit the sections together to restore the rose-themed picture at your preferred difficulty.

pages.title: Ultimate Car Racing Game 2020
pages.creator: zuma studio
pages.description: Drive through crowded routes in Ultimate Car Racing Game 2020. Avoid crashes, collect coins, and take opportunities for high-speed stunts while traveling across city and countryside roads. The ongoing driving challenge combines handling traffic with extending the race.

pages.title: Hands Attack
pages.creator: TrendyGames
pages.description: Test your reactions against a friend in Hands Attack, a two-player contest inspired by the hand-slapping game. Time an attack to catch the opposing hand, or pull away when defending. Anticipating the other player's move matters as much as reacting to it.

pages.title: Santa Gravity Run
pages.creator: Bnagames
pages.description: Reverse the pull on a holiday character in Santa Gravity Run. Switch gravity to guide Santa around obstacles and toward the door. Twelve levels present different routes, requiring you to choose when the next change will create a safe crossing.

pages.title: Candy Christmas
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Swap festive sweets in Candy Christmas. Make groups of at least three matching candies to earn points and keep the board clearing. Use Santa-themed bombs when a difficult arrangement calls for a larger explosion to open space.

pages.title: Santa Claus Gift Bag Jigsaw
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Assemble holiday pictures in Santa Claus Gift Bag Jigsaw. Twelve images offer puzzles with 25, 49, or 100 pieces. Choose a layout and fit every section into position to reveal the complete Christmas illustration.

pages.title: Ducati Panigale Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Rebuild motorcycle photographs in Ducati Panigale Puzzle. Six images offer four piece counts, from sixteen to one hundred. Pick a difficulty and compare the bike's details across the scattered sections to restore the selected picture.

pages.title: Galaxy Wars
pages.creator: Good Funny Game
pages.description: Defend your ship in Galaxy Wars. Move horizontally across the battlefield and shoot at the enemies approaching from above. Keep clearing the invading formation while avoiding the attacks that threaten your spacecraft's survival.

pages.title: Rooftop Snipers
pages.creator: New Eich Games
pages.description: Knock an opponent off the map in Rooftop Snipers. Jump to reposition and hold, then release, the shooting control to fire. The chaotic two-button contest supports either a computer opponent or a friend playing alongside you locally.

pages.title: Where's My Golf?
pages.creator: BestGamesFreePlay.com
pages.description: Draw a route to the hole in Where's My Golf?. Guide the ball across each of forty puzzles by placing lines that support its movement. Collect coins during the course and use them to unlock additional golf-ball designs.

pages.title: Mad Day Special
pages.creator: SMOKOKO LTD
pages.description: Rescue a pet octopus during an alien invasion in Mad Day Special. Drive an armed truck over hills, blast through obstacles, and continue fighting on foot when needed. Improve weapons, armor, and other equipment to help reach Fluffy and escape the attackers.

pages.title: Barbaric Match 3
pages.creator: Shunda Inc
pages.description: Clear matching pieces in Barbaric Match 3. Arrange rows of three or more identical monster-themed items to gain points. Keep the side meter from falling too far by continuing to make productive matches through the changing board.

pages.title: Trivia Quiz
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Work through general-knowledge rounds in Trivia Quiz. Answer thirty questions drawn from a larger collection, beginning with easier entries before facing harder ones. Compare how many you can solve correctly as the round tests knowledge across different subjects.

pages.title: Hex Blaster
pages.creator: DAB3Games
pages.description: Break descending targets in Hex Blaster. Aim balls upward to remove hexagons before they reach the bottom of the screen, collecting helpful power-ups along the way. Choose endless or level-based play and unlock skins and upgrades as you build your score.

pages.title: Easy Math
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Answer arithmetic questions against a countdown in Easy Math. Check each problem, choose the correct result, and add to your score with accurate answers. Keep working through the questions while the remaining time limits how long you can continue the math challenge.

pages.title: Axe Champ
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: Hit breakable targets in Axe Champ. Aim the axe and choose the moment to send it toward the object ahead. The challenge focuses on placing successful strikes as you work through the game's sequence of target-breaking attempts.

pages.title: Jungle TD
pages.creator: BeedoGames
pages.description: Protect a jungle base in Jungle TD. Place defensive towers where they can cover the monsters' route and choose the weapons suited to each wave. Stop the attackers before they reach the tent, adjusting the defense as the battle continues.

pages.title: Stickman Rise Up
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Guard a rising character in Stickman Rise Up. Move the shield to sweep swords, saws, razors, and shurikens away from the balloon carrying the stick figure. Collect diamonds for customization and keep the route clear to reach higher into the clouds.

pages.title: Real Flight Simulator
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Prepare and pilot aircraft in Real Flight Simulator. Follow the startup sequence by enabling lights, configuring flaps, starting the engines, and increasing throttle. Manage the plane's controls as you take it into the sky and practice handling the simulated flight.

pages.title: Metal Animal
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Place armed creatures on a moving defense in Metal Animal. Drag foxes, cats, pandas, or other fighters into useful positions on the tank. Keep the crew organized against unlimited enemy waves and prevent the opposing animals from destroying the vehicle.

pages.title: Stick Tank Wars
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Trade angled shots in Stick Tank Wars. Choose a weapon, line up the trajectory, and fire quickly enough to defeat the opposing tank. Collect coins for vehicle improvements and stronger ammunition as you work through further armored confrontations.

pages.title: Abandoned University Html5 Escape
pages.creator: Yolkgames
pages.description: Search a deserted campus in Abandoned University Html5 Escape. Inspect rooms, collect clues, and solve the point-and-click puzzles needed to find a secret book. Recovering that object is the key task in opening a way out of the university.

pages.title: Blocky Squad
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Command a fighting force in Blocky Squad. Build up the battalion and move its units strategically through the war encounters. Keep the soldiers alive while choosing how to confront the opposition and secure the battlefield for your side.

pages.title: Bubble Shooter Extreme
pages.creator: CMC Online s.r.o.
pages.description: Clear the complete field in Bubble Shooter Extreme. Aim matching shots to remove bubbles, with larger single-shot clears earning more points. Use the available rewarded assistance when the difficult arrangement leaves you struggling to eliminate the last sections.

pages.title: FGP Pyramid Solitaire
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Remove cards totaling thirteen in FGP Pyramid Solitaire. Find usable pairs across the pyramid and clear the arrangement to complete the board. Keep looking for combinations that uncover more cards as you work toward solving further deals.

pages.title: No Right Turn
pages.creator: Casual_Azerion_Old
pages.description: Guide a moving block through a grid in No Right Turn using only left turns. Click to change direction at the right moment, avoiding barriers and the edge of the board. Plan the next corner before the block reaches a position it cannot escape.

pages.title: Ice Queen Laundry Day
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description: Complete a clothing-care routine in Ice Queen Laundry Day. Separate colored and white garments, add detergent, and run the washing machine. Dry the cleaned clothes outdoors and iron them before putting the neat garments back into the wardrobe.

pages.title: College Princess Spa Makeup H5
pages.creator: GlossyPlay
pages.description: Prepare a student for class in College Princess Spa Makeup H5. Work through facial spa activities, apply masks, and choose cosmetics for the finished look. Coordinate the makeup as you complete the princess's preparation for returning to college.
